paragraphs: Navitas Semiconductor Corporation ("we," us," "Navitas" or the "Company") designs, develops and markets next-generation power semiconductors including gallium nitride (GaN) power integrated circuits (ICs), high-voltage silicon carbide (SiC) devices and associated high-speed silicon system controllers, and digital isolators used in power conversion and charging. We focus on high-power markets including artificial intelligence ("AI") data centers, energy and grid infrastructure, performance computing and industrial electrification.

Our products are engineered to deliver superior efficiency, performance, power density, and sustainability compared to legacy, silicon-based technologies. By leveraging the unique properties of wide bandgap (WBG) materials such as GaN and SiC, our solutions enable higher power throughput, higher voltage operation, improved thermal performance, and reduced system size and cost, which are critical advantages for high-power applications such as hyperscale and AI data centers, grid electrification, high-performance computing clusters, and industrial automation. We operate as a product design house that contracts the manufacturing of its chips and packaging to partner suppliers.

Through this focus on high-power markets, we are positioned to support the global transition to electrification and energy conservation. Our mission is to drive innovation in high-frequency, high-efficiency, and high-density power electronics, enabling our customers to achieve greater energy savings, operational reliability, and sustainability. By unlocking new levels of speed and efficiency, Navitas is leading the transformation of power electronics to "Electrify Our World"™ for a cleaner, more connected future.

Navitas Semiconductor Corporation was originally incorporated as Live Oak Acquisition Corp. II. On October 19, 2021, as part of a series of related transactions (which we refer to as the "Business Combination"), the registrant acquired all of the equity interests of Navitas Semiconductor Limited, an Irish private company domesticated in Delaware as Navitas Semiconductor Ireland, LLC (collectively, "Legacy Navitas") and changed the name of the registrant to Navitas Semiconductor Corporation. As a result, Legacy Navitas became a wholly owned subsidiary of Navitas Semiconductor Corporation effective October 19, 2021.

Legacy Navitas was founded in 2014, and since that time, has successfully harnessed the fundamentally superior material properties of GaN to enable cost savings and enhanced power conversion. With ten-times stronger electrical fields and twice the electron mobility compared to silicon, GaN is ideally suited for disrupting power switching applications, but challenges around process, quality and reliability made commercialization difficult. By developing a fully qualified manufacturing process with over one billion device hours tested, Navitas overcame these key hurdles to successfully and reliably integrate the critical drive, control and protection circuits into a single chip, enabling mainstream GaN adoption and unlocking the full potential of GaN in speed, efficiency, simplicity and cost.

In August 2022, Navitas acquired GeneSiC Semiconductor, adding a broad range of SiC MOSFETs and diodes to the Navitas portfolio. GeneSiC proprietary trench-assisted planar-grade MOSFET technology combines the best of planar SiC (ease of manufacturing, robustness) with the best of trench SiC (low resistance, smaller die sizes). Navitas SiC MOSFETs have lower resistance at higher temperatures, and operate at cooler temperatures, for expected 3x longer device life expectancy.

In late 2025, we announced a strategic pivot that we called "Navitas 2.0," which entailed an enhanced focus on high-power markets, including AI data centers, energy and grid infrastructure, performance computing and industrial electrification, and a de-emphasis on mobile and consumer products. In connection with this pivot, we restructured the organization, reallocating resources and priorities in support of these high-power markets.

We believe that the combination of GaN and SiC expertise and technologies makes Navitas particularly well-suited to compete and succeed in these emerging high-power markets. In addition, we have an impressive track record of manufacturing and shipping GaN and SiC devices at scale. As of December 31, 2025, we have shipped over 300 million GaN devices and nearly 30 million SiC devices with proven quality and field-reliability performance.

Navitas is led by a team of veteran power semiconductor industry experts with deep business and technical experience in semiconductor materials, devices, applications, systems and marketing. We maintain operations around the world, including the United States, Ireland, Germany, Italy, Belgium, China, Taiwan, Thailand, South Korea and the Philippines. Our principal executive offices are located in Torrance, California and we have satellite offices in Santa Clara, California and Irvine, California. We have a strong legacy of innovation, with over 300 patents issued or pending, and we are proud to be the world's first semiconductor company to be CarbonNeutral™-certified.

Electronic devices that run on electrical power need power converters to adapt voltage levels required for the particular use case. Depending on the application, there is a huge range of power and voltages, and hence there are various types of power semiconductors and power conversion topologies. Until recently, only silicon (Si) based devices were available, limiting the choices for our customers. With the advent of gallium nitride (GaN) and silicon carbide (SiC), also called wide bandgap (WBG), power semiconductor technologies, there has been a vast improvement in cost of ownership, efficiency, size, and weight of these power converters owing to the superior performance characteristics of WBG devices. Moreover, many new applications are enabled only because of the performance delivered by these devices. In 2025, industry sources indicate that GaN and SiC power semiconductors constituted only a small fraction of the total power semiconductor devices shipped in 2025, leaving the majority of the market still to traditional Si devices. We believe that GaN and SiC devices are on cusp of widespread adoption, particularly in high power applications, and Navitas is focused on pursuing those markets.

Specifically, Navitas has identified four key end markets where we expect rapid and widespread adoption of GaN and SiC technologies: AI data center, energy and grid infrastructure, performance computing and industrial electrification. These markets are driven by major, long-term secular trends including explosive growth in AI computing and data center construction, increasing energy costs and the long overdue need to upgrade electrical grids and power infrastructure.

AI & Data Center. Demand for better power conversion solutions in AI data centers is exploding as GPUs and NPUs demand more power while requiring the same physical space. As server power racks increase the power required per rack, solutions based on wide bandgap devices such as Navitas GaN and SiC devices have become a necessity, replacing older Si-based solutions. Navitas's capability to engineer GaN and SiC-based devices by investing in system-level know-how makes it a recognized supplier in this market.

Energy and Grid Infrastructure. As demand for datacenter power evolves, so does the need for better solutions for the delivery of power to datacenters. Traditional 50/60Hz transformers no longer meet the efficiency, space, and uptime requirements for modern datacenters. Solid State Transformer is a latest generation of power electronics solution that operates from an input voltage of 11 to 13 KV AC and delivers an output voltage of 800 VDC standard or 1500 VDC standard. These SSTs deliver higher system efficiency compared to a traditional grid solution while also providing better system uptime at a lower cost of ownership in a smaller space. Navitas's GaN and SiC devices are the leading choice by many OEMs investing in datacenter infrastructure.

Performance Computing. GaN Power devices are generally accepted in high-power-density chargers for high-end computers, replacing their Si-based predecessors. As AI adoption accelerates, more AI functions are expected to be enabled on edge, such as a laptop computer, requiring higher power to operate and hence more advanced charging solutions. Navitas has developed a broad line of GaN power devices and ICs offering optimal choices to customers based on their needs.

headings: Risks Related to Our Business and Customers
Risks Related to Owning Our Common Stock
Our success and future revenue depends on our ability to achieve design wins and to convince our current and prospective end customers to design our products into their product offerings.

If we fail in a timely and cost-effective manner to develop new product features or new products that address end customer preferences and achieve market acceptance, our operating results could be adversely affected.

Our ability to accurately predict future revenues and profits is inherently subject to significant uncertainties, particularly as our products are designed to disrupt existing markets and create new or emerging markets.
We maintain a backlog of customer orders that is subject to cancellation, reduction or delay in delivery schedules, which may result in lower than expected revenues.
We depend on a few key distributors and the loss of one or more of these distributors could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition and results of operations.

If our foundry vendors and other suppliers do not achieve satisfactory yields or quality, our reputation and end customer relationships could be harmed, and we could be exposed to additional expenses and liability.

Raw material price fluctuations can increase the cost of our products, impact our ability to meet end customer commitments, and may adversely affect our results of operations, including our gross margin.
We are subject to risks and uncertainties associated with international operations, which may harm our business.
paragraphs: The below summary of risk factors provides an overview of many of the risks we are exposed to in the normal course of our business activities. As a result, the below summary risks do not contain all of the information that may be important to you, and you should read the summary risks together with the more detailed and complete discussion of risks set forth under the heading "Risk Factors" in Part I, Item 1A of this annual report, as well as elsewhere in this annual report. Additional risks, beyond those summarized below or discussed elsewhere in this annual report, may apply to our activities or operations as currently conducted or as we may conduct them in the future or in the markets in which we operate or may in the future operate.
Consistent with the foregoing, we are exposed to a variety of risks, including risks associated with the following:

•Our increased focus on AI data centers, energy and grid infrastructure, performance computing and industrial electrification, and our reduced emphasis on mobile and consumer products, may not achieve the anticipated results.
•Our success and future revenue depend on our ability to achieve design wins and to convince our current and prospective end customers to design our products into their product offerings.

•Even if we are awarded a design win, expected revenues typically do not result for one year or more, if ever. Further, revenues from design wins may not materialize if our customer changes, cancels or delays the selection or if our customer's products are not successful.

•If we fail in a timely and cost-effective manner to develop new product features or new products that address end customer preferences and achieve market acceptance, our operating results could be adversely affected.

Navitas Semiconductor Corporation designs, develops and markets next-generation power semiconductors, including gallium nitride ("GaN") power integrated circuits ("ICs"), high-voltage silicon carbide ("SiC") devices, associated high-speed silicon system controllers, and digital isolators used in power conversion and charging applications. We focus primarily on high-power markets, including AI data centers, energy and grid infrastructure, performance computing and industrial electrification. Our products are designed to improve system efficiency, increase power density, enhance thermal performance, and reduce overall system size and cost compared to traditional silicon-based technologies.

By leveraging the electrical properties of wide bandgap ("WBG") materials such as GaN and SiC, our solutions enable higher switching frequencies, higher voltage operation, and improved energy efficiency. These capabilities are increasingly important in applications such as hyperscale data centers, renewable energy systems, grid modernization infrastructure, and industrial automation.

We operate as a fabless semiconductor design company and outsource wafer fabrication, assembly, and testing to qualified third-party manufacturing partners. This business model allows us to operate with relatively low capital expenditure requirements; however, our results depend on the capacity, cost structure, yield performance, and operational execution of our manufacturing partners. We maintain operations around the world, including the United States, Ireland, Germany, Italy, Belgium, China, Taiwan, South Korea, and the Philippines, with principal executive offices in Torrance, California.
Private Placement of Common Stock ("PIPE" Offering)

On November 7, 2025, we entered into the Purchase Agreement with accredited investors for a private placement of approximately 14.8 million shares of Class A common stock at $6.75 per share. The transaction closed on November 10, 2025, with Needham & Company as sole placement agent, resulting in gross proceeds of approximately $100.0 million and offering-related costs of $4.4 million. Net proceeds are being used for working capital and general corporate purposes, including support of strategic initiatives in high-power markets. All shares were delivered and settled in the fourth quarter of 2025.

On March 19, 2025, we entered into an Open Market Sale AgreementSM (the "Sale Agreement") with Jefferies LLC ("Jefferies"). We subsequently completed two "At the Market" (ATM) offerings referred to as ATM One and ATM Two, respectively. Pursuant to each agreement, we could offer and sell, from time to time, shares of our Class A common stock, par value $0.0001 per share, having an aggregate offering price of up to $50.0 million through Jefferies as sales agent. As of June 30, 2025, we completed the sale of shares under both ATM One and ATM Two resulting in approximately 11.1 million shares under ATM One and 8.7 million shares under ATM Two, with gross proceeds of approximately $100.0 million and offering-related costs of $3.3 million in total. All sales were completed in the second quarter of 2025.

During the fourth quarter of 2025, we have undertaken a strategic transformation ("Navitas 2.0 Restructuring Plan") to reposition the Company as a focused high-power semiconductor company serving large, durable, higher-margin markets. The fourth quarter 2025 total restructuring expense and impairment charges incurred by us were $16.6 million. See Note - 18 "Restructuring and Impairment" to the Consolidated Financial Statements in Item 8 of this report for further details on the restructuring expense and impairment charges.

The Navitas 2.0 Restructuring Plan shifts the Company away from consumer-oriented, short-life-cycle segments toward long-term programs in AI data centers, energy and grid infrastructure, performance computing and industrial electrification. This pivot is expected to improve business predictability, expand gross margin, and support a scalable and sustainable operating model. To enable this transition, we took several decisive actions focusing on 1) distributor rationalization, 2) resource realignment, 3) technology roadmap acceleration, and 4) go-to-market restructuring. Additionally, these actions support a disciplined operating model centered on four strategic pillars:
1.Market focus: AI data centers, energy and grid infrastructure, performance computing and industrial electrification.
2.Technology leadership: continuous innovation in GaN, GaN power ICs, and high-voltage silicon carbide, informed by customer requirements and co-design.
3.Operational efficiency: a streamlined and rebalanced geographically deployed organization, a scalable foundry, and packaging and module partnerships.
4.Financial discipline: prioritized investments, leverageable operating expenses, and a mix shift toward high-margin programs.

Navitas Semiconductor Corporation ("we," us," "Navitas" or the "Company") 研發、設計與行銷次世代電源半導體元件，包括氮化鎵 (GaN) 電源積體電路 (ICs)、高壓碳化矽 (SiC) 產品與相關高頻率矽系統控制器，以及用於電源轉換與充電的數位隔離器。我們專注於高功率市場，包括人工智慧 ("AI") 資料中心、能源與電網基礎建設、高性能計算與工業電氣化。
我們的產品設計用以提供優於傳統矽基技術的效率、性能、電源密度與永續性。透過善用寬能隙 (WBG) 材料如氮化鎵與碳化矽的獨特特性，我們的解決方案可實現更高的電力輸出、更高的電壓運作、改善的熱性能，以及更小的系統尺寸與成本，這對高功率應用如超規模與人工智慧資料中心、電網電氣化、高性能計算叢集與工業自動化而言，是關鍵優勢。我們運作模式為產品設計公司，將晶片與封裝製造委外給合作供應商。
透過對高功率市場的專注，我們已具備支持全球電氣化與能源節約轉型的條件。我們的使命是推動高頻率、高效率與高密度電源電子的創新，協助客戶實現更高的能源節省、運作可靠性與永續性。透過釋放新的速度與效率層級，Navitas 正領導電源電子的轉型，實現 "Electrify Our World"™，以打造更乾淨、更連結的未來。

Navitas Semiconductor Corporation 最初成立為 Live Oak Acquisition Corp. II。2021 年 10 月 19 日，作為一連串相關交易（我們稱為 "業務合併"）的一部分，註冊人取得了 Navitas Semiconductor Limited 的全部股權，Navitas Semiconductor Limited 為一設立於愛爾蘭、註冊於特拉華州的私人公司，名為 Navitas Semiconductor Ireland, LLC（合稱 "Legacy Navitas"），並更名為 Navitas Semiconductor Corporation。因此，Legacy Navitas 自 2021 年 10 月 19 日起成為 Navitas Semiconductor Corporation 的 wholly owned subsidiary。

Legacy Navitas 於 2014 年成立，自那時起，已成功運用氮化鎵的本質優越材料特性，實現成本節省與提升電力轉換效率。與矽相比，氮化鎵具有十倍強的電場與兩倍的電子遷移率，非常適合用於電源切換應用的創新，但製程、品質與可靠性方面的挑戰使商業化困難。透過開發一個經過完整驗證的製造流程，並進行超過十億個裝置小時的測試，Navitas 已克服這些關鍵挑戰，成功且可靠地將關鍵驅動、控制與保護電路整合至單一晶片，實現氮化鎵的主流應用，並釋放其在速度、效率、簡化與成本方面的全部潛力。

2022 年 8 月，Navitas 收購 GeneSiC Semiconductor，為 Navitas 的產品組合增添了廣泛的碳化矽 MOSFET 與二極體。GeneSiC 的專利溝槽輔助平面級 MOSFET 技術結合了平面碳化矽（製造容易、強韌）與溝槽碳化矽（低電阻、較小晶片尺寸）的最佳特性。Navitas 的碳化矽 MOSFET 在較高溫度下具有較低的電阻，並在較低溫度下運作，預期可使裝置壽命延長三倍。
2025 年底，我們宣佈了一項戰略轉型，我們稱為 "Navitas 2.0"，這包括加強對高功率市場的關注，包括人工智慧資料中心、能源與電網基礎建設、高性能計算與工業電氣化，並減少對行動與消費性產品的關注。配合此轉型，我們重整組織，重新分配資源與優先順序，以支持這些高功率市場。
我們認為，GaN 與 SiC 專業知識與技術的結合，使 Navitas 特別適合在這些新興高功率市場中競爭並取得成功。此外，我們在大規模製造與出貨 GaN 與 SiC 產品方面有著令人印象深刻的紀錄。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我們已出貨超過 300 百萬顆 GaN 產品與近 30 百萬顆 SiC 產品，且其品質與現場可靠性表現已得到驗證。

Navitas 由一羣具豐富電源半導體產業經驗的資深專家團隊領導，具備深厚的半導體材料、元件、應用、系統與行銷業務與技術經驗。我們在全球多個地區維持運作，包括美國、愛爾蘭、德國、義大利、比利時、中國、臺灣、泰國、韓國及菲律賓。我們的總部位於加州託倫斯市，並在加州聖克拉拉市與加州爾灣市設有分處。我們擁有強大的創新傳統，已取得或申請中之專利超過 300 項，並為全球第一家取得 CarbonNeutral™ 認證的半導體公司。

運行於電力的電子裝置需要電壓轉換器來適應特定應用所需的電壓水平。根據應用的不同，電力與電壓的範圍極為廣泛，因此有各種類型的電源半導體與電壓轉換拓撲結構。直到最近，僅有基於矽 (Si) 的裝置可供使用，限制了我們客戶的選擇。隨著氮化鎵 (GaN) 與碳化矽 (SiC)，也稱為寬能隙 (WBG) 電源半導體技術的出現，這些電壓轉換器在成本、效率、尺寸與重量方面都有顯著改善，這是因為 WBG 裝置具有優越的性能特徵。此外，許多新的應用僅因這些裝置的性能而得以實現。根據產業來源，2025 年 GaN 與 SiC 電源半導體僅佔 2025 年總電源半導體裝置出貨量的一小部分，剩餘市場仍由傳統 Si 裝置佔據。我們相信 GaN 與 SiC 裝置即將廣泛應用，特別是在高功率應用領域，Navitas 並專注於追求這些市場。
具體而言，Navitas 已辨識出四個關鍵終端市場，我們預期 GaN 與 SiC 技術將快速且廣泛應用：AI 資料中心、能源與電網基礎設施、高性能計算與工業電氣化。這些市場受到主要、長期的產業趨勢驅動，包括 AI 計算與資料中心建設的爆炸性成長、能源成本的增加，以及電網與電力基礎設施長久以來的更新需求。

AI & 資料中心。隨著 GPU 與 NPU 需求的電力增加，同時要求相同的物理空間，資料中心對更優良的電壓轉換解決方案需求急劇成長。隨著伺服器電力機架每機架所需電力增加，基於寬能隙裝置（如 Navitas 的 GaN 與 SiC 裝置）的解決方案已成為必要，取代較舊的 Si 基礎解決方案。Navitas 能透過投資系統層級的知識，工程 GaN 與 SiC 基礪的裝置，使其成為此市場的知名供應商。

能源與電網基礎設施。隨著資料中心電力需求的演進，對電力送達資料中心的解決方案也持續進化。傳統 50/60Hz 變壓器已無法符合現代資料中心在效率、空間與運轉時間的要件。固態變壓器（SST）是最新一代的電力電子解決方案，其輸入電壓為 11 至 13 千伏交流電，並輸出 800 V 直流標準或 1500 V 直流標準電壓。這些 SST 提供比傳統電網解決方案更高的系統效率，同時在更小的空間內提供更好的系統運轉時間，且擁有更低的擁有成本。Navitas 的 GaN 與 SiC 裝置是許多 OEM 投資資料中心基礎設施時的首選選擇。
高性能計算。GaN 電源裝置一般已被接受用於高功率密度充電器中，用以取代其 Si 基礎的前身。隨著 AI 的採用加速，預期將有更多 AI 功能在邊緣設備上啟動，例如筆記型電腦，這需要更高的電力運作，因此需要更先進的充電解決方案。Navitas 已開發出一系列 GaN 電源裝置與 IC，根據客戶的需要提供最佳選擇。

您應將下列對我們財務狀況及營運成果之討論與分析，與我們之財務報表及相關附註說明一併閱讀。本討論包含前瞻性陳述，反映我們之計畫、預估與信念，並涉及風險與不確定性。由於許多因素，例如於 "風險因素" 及 "前瞻性陳述警示" 章節及其他本年度報告中所列舉者，我們實際結果可能與這些前瞻性陳述所預期者有重大差異。

Navitas Semiconductor Corporation 設計、開發及行銷新一代之電力半導體，包括氮化鎵（"GaN"）電力整合電路（"ICs"）、高壓碳化矽（"SiC"）元件、相關高頻矽系統控制器，以及用於電力轉換與充電應用之數位隔離器。我們主要專注於高功率市場，包括人工智慧資料中心、能源與電網基礎建設、高性能計算與工業電氣化。我們之產品設計旨在提升系統效率、增加電力密度、改善熱性能，並較傳統矽基技術降低整體系統尺寸與成本。
透過利用寬能隙（"WBG"）材料如 GaN 與 SiC 之電氣特性，我們之解決方案可實現較高切換頻率、較高電壓操作及改善之能源效率。這些能力在超規模資料中心、可再生能源系統、電網現代化基礎建設及工業自動化等應用中越來越重要。
我們為一無晶圓廠半導體設計公司，將晶圓製造、組裝與測試委外給合格之第三方製造夥伴。此商業模式使我們得以以相對低之資本支出運作；然而，我們之結果依賴製造夥伴之產能、成本結構、良率表現及營運執行能力。我們在全球多處設有營運據點，包括美國、愛爾蘭、德國、義大利、比利時、中國、臺灣、韓國及菲律賓，總部設於加州託倫斯。
普通股私募發行（"PIPE" 發行）

2025 年 11 月 7 日，我們與認購資格投資人簽訂購股協議，進行約 14.8 百萬股 A 級普通股之私募發行，每股 $6.75。交易於 2025 年 11 月 10 日完成，Needham & Company 為獨家發行經紀人，產生約 100.0 百萬美元之淨收入，並產生 $4.4 百萬之發行相關費用。淨收入將用於營運資金及一般企業用途，包括支持高功率市場之戰略計畫。所有股票於 2025 年第四季完成交付與結算。

2025 年 3 月 19 日，我們與 Jefferies LLC（"Jefferies"）簽訂公開市場銷售協議（"Sale Agreement"）。隨後我們完成兩次 "公開市場"（ATM）發行，分別稱為 ATM One 與 ATM Two。根據每項協議，我們可隨時發行與銷售本公司 A 級普通股，每股票面價值 $0.0001，總發行價格上限為 $50.0 百萬，透過 Jefferies 作為銷售經紀人。截至 2025 年 6 月 30 日，我們已完成 ATM One 與 ATM Two 之股票銷售，分別產生約 11.1 百萬股與 8.7 百萬股，總計產生約 100.0 百萬美元之淨收入，並產生 $3.3 百萬之發行相關費用。所有銷售於 2025 年第二季完成。

於 2025 年第四季，本公司已啟動一項戰略轉型（"Navitas 2.0 Restructuring Plan"），以將本公司重新定位為專注於高功率半導體的公司，服務大型、耐用且高毛利市場。本公司於 2025 年第四季所產生的總重整費用及減損費用為 16.6 百萬美元。有關重整費用及減損費用的詳細資訊，請參閱本報告第 8 項「綜合財務報表」中附註 18 "Restructuring and Impairment"。

Navitas 2.0 Restructuring Plan 將本公司從以消費者為導向、短產品週期的業務部門，轉向 AI 資料中心、能源與電網基礎設施、效能計算及工業電動化等長遠計畫。此轉變預期將提高業務可預測性、擴大毛利率，並支持可擴展且可持續的營運模式。為實現此轉變，本公司已採取若干關鍵行動，重點在於 1) 電腦商理清、2) 資源重新配置、3) 技術路線圖加速、4) 市場推廣重整。此外，這些行動也支持一個以四大戰略支柱為中心的嚴謹營運模式：
1.市場聚焦：AI 資料中心、能源與電網基礎設施、效能計算及工業電動化。
2.技術領導：持續創新於氮化鎵（GaN）、氮化鎵功率積體電路（GaN power ICs）及高壓碳化矽（high-voltage silicon carbide），並根據客戶需求及共同設計進行。
3.營運效率：一個簡化且重新平衡的地理部署組織、可擴展的晶圓廠，以及封裝與模組合作夥伴。
4.財務紀律：優先投資、可運用的營運費用，以及朝向高毛利計畫的產品組合轉變。

與智慧財產權相關之風險
與本公司普通股相關之風險
本公司之成功及未來營業收入取決於本公司能否取得設計勝利，並說服現有及潛在終端客戶將本公司產品設計至其產品組閤中。
若本公司未能以具成本效益的方式及時開發新產品功能或新產品，以符合終端客戶偏好並獲得市場接受，將可能對本公司營運成果造成不利影響。
本公司預測未來營業收入與利潤的能力，本質上受到重大不確定性影響，尤其因本公司產品旨在顛覆現有市場並創造新興市場。
本公司維持客戶訂單的積壓，而這些訂單可能遭取消、減少或延遲交貨，這可能導致實際收入低於預期。
本公司依賴少數關鍵經銷商，若失去其中一至數家經銷商，將可能對本公司業務、財務狀況及營運成果造成重大不利影響。
若本公司晶圓代工廠及其他供應商無法達成滿意的良率或品質，將可能損害本公司聲譽與終端客戶關係，並使本公司面臨額外支出與責任。
原物料價格波動可能提高本公司產品成本，影響本公司履行終端客戶承諾的能力，並可能對本公司營運成果造成不利影響，包括毛利率。
本公司面臨國際業務相關的風險與不確定性，這可能對本公司業務造成損害。
paragraphs: 以下風險因素的總結提供許多我們在正常業務活動中所面臨的風險概覽。因此，以下總結的風險並未包含所有對您可能重要的資訊，您應將總結的風險與本年度報告第一部分第 1A 項標題為「風險因素」的更詳細且完整的風險討論內容一併閱讀，同時也應參考本年度報告其他部分的相關資訊。除了以下總結的風險或本年度報告其他部分討論的風險之外，可能還有其他風險適用於我們目前或未來可能進行的業務活動或運作，或我們目前或未來可能經營的市場。
根據上述內容，我們面臨多種風險，包括與以下事項相關的風險：
•我們對 AI 資料中心、能源與電網基礎設施、高性能計算與工業電氣化領域的關注度增加，以及對行動與消費性產品的關注度降低，可能無法達到預期的結果。
•我們的成功與未來營業收入取決於我們能否取得設計勝利，並說服現有與潛在終端客戶將我們的產品設計至其產品組閤中。
•即使我們取得設計勝利，預期收入通常需要一年或更長時間才會實現，甚至可能永遠無法實現。此外，若客戶變更、取消或延遲選定，或客戶的產品未成功，則來自設計勝利的收入可能無法實現。
•若我們未能以及時且成本效益的方式開發符合終端客戶偏好、並取得市場接受度的新產品功能或新產品，我們的營運結果可能受到不利影響。
